dfm_alerts.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.43°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('MT-11010 texture') needs.
dfm_alerts.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 113.37 mm² (curved, 148.02 mm² at [-49.91, -49.91, 7.11]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Projected area along +Z: 21162 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 108.2 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 130 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.45 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
dfm_alerts.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 12120 ray samples into the material (median 2.2 mm)

dfm_alerts.description: Magnetic head/stem coupling needs a controlled air gap; anodising adds ~20 µm per side.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify 0.3 ± 0.1 mm air gap after finishing and mask pogo contact area before anodising.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Type II anodising build-up ~50% outward growth — MIL-A-8625 guidance

dfm_alerts.description: 18650 cell sits against the LED driver area; heat and pinch risk during assembly.
dfm_alerts.fix: Add a cell cradle rib with 2 mm clearance and a thermal barrier; cell protection circuit mandatory.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: IEC 62133-2 cell protection and thermal abuse clauses
